verdicts.reason: A: the left-to-right order (phone, then headline and terms, then CTA) suits the banner and the right margin is comfortable, but the headline is undersized for the canvas. There is also a dead gap between the text block and the CTA, and the phone nearly touches the top and bottom edges. B: the larger headline gives better hierarchy, but the headline runs to within about 30px of the CTA. The CTA is jammed near the right edge and its pill ends look clipped or squared, so the right side feels cramped while the left side has slack.
